# Photo & Video Documentation Guide

Thorough visual evidence significantly strengthens your warranty claim. Follow this guide to capture clear, compelling documentation of the flickering issue.

---

## 📹 Video Documentation (Most Important)

Since flickering is intermittent and hard to capture in photos, **video is your strongest evidence**.

### How to record

1. **Environment** — Record in a dimly lit or dark room so the flickering is clearly visible
2. **Stability** — Use a tripod or prop your phone against a stable surface; avoid handheld shake
3. **Duration** — Record for **2–5 minutes** continuously to capture multiple flicker events
4. **Angle** — Film the lamp head-on from about 2–3 feet away, keeping the full lamp in frame
5. **Narration** — Briefly narrate while recording:
   - State the date and your name
   - Identify the product ("This is my Aurora Smart Desk Lamp Pro")
   - Describe what's happening ("The lamp is flickering intermittently as you can see")
   - Note the power source ("The lamp is plugged directly into a wall outlet")

### Recommended recordings

| Video | Description | Suggested filename |
|-------|-------------|--------------------|
| **Main flicker evidence** | Continuous recording showing the flickering | `flickering-evidence-main.mp4` |
| **Different settings** | Show flickering across brightness/color modes | `flickering-different-modes.mp4` |
| **Power source test** | Show the issue persists with a different outlet | `flickering-different-outlet.mp4` |
| **Reset demonstration** | Record the reset process and flickering resuming | `flickering-after-reset.mp4` |

### Video tips
- Use your phone's **highest resolution** (1080p or 4K)
- Turn off any nearby flickering light sources (other lamps, screens) to avoid confusion
- If the flicker is subtle, try using **slow-motion mode** to make it more visible
- Keep the camera's **auto-exposure locked** so the recording doesn't compensate for the flicker

---

## 📸 Photo Documentation

Photos supplement your videos and show the overall condition of the product.

### Recommended photos

| Photo | Description | Suggested filename |
|-------|-------------|--------------------|
| **Product overview** | Full lamp, front view, powered on | `lamp-front-overview.jpg` |
| **Serial number / label** | Close-up of the model and serial number sticker | `serial-number-label.jpg` |
| **Setup / power** | Lamp plugged into the wall outlet | `power-setup.jpg` |
| **Mid-flicker (if possible)** | Capture during a flicker event | `mid-flicker-capture.jpg` |
| **Product condition** | Show the lamp is in good physical condition (no damage) | `lamp-condition.jpg` |
| **Packaging / box** | Original packaging if still available | `original-packaging.jpg` |

### Photo tips
- Use good ambient lighting (besides the lamp itself) for clear photos
- Ensure the serial number and product label are **sharp and legible**
- Avoid using flash — it can wash out details

---

## 📁 File Organization

Save all files in this folder using the suggested filenames:

```
photos-and-videos/
├── DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md          ← This guide
├── flickering-evidence-main.mp4
├── flickering-different-modes.mp4
├── flickering-different-outlet.mp4
├── flickering-after-reset.mp4
├── lamp-front-overview.jpg
├── serial-number-label.jpg
├── power-setup.jpg
├── mid-flicker-capture.jpg
├── lamp-condition.jpg
└── original-packaging.jpg
```

---

## ✅ Documentation Checklist

- [ ] At least one video clearly showing the flickering
- [ ] Video showing the issue across different lamp settings
- [ ] Video showing the issue persists after a reset
- [ ] Photo of the full lamp
- [ ] Photo of the serial number / product label
- [ ] Photo showing the power setup
- [ ] Photo of overall lamp condition (no physical damage)
